name: FNB App Academy 2026
requirements: Open to anyone interested in app development. Applicants take a proficiency test that sorts them into beginner, intermediate or advanced groups.
timing: 2026 intake under way. Check the academy page for the current schedule.
accreditation: NQF 5 through UJ Business School (2026), per communication to programme participants. Not stated on the public page.
notes: The FAQ page (last edited November 2025) describes the 2025 edition as SETA accredited at NQF 5, which conflicts with other information. Confirm the cost and accreditation on the 2026 academy page.

name: CAPACITI IT Learnership
field: IT (IT Support, AI and Machine Learning streams in the 2025 listing)
requirements: Full-time attendance Monday to Friday, 08:00-17:00, for 12 months (from the 2025 Johannesburg listing). Other requirements to be confirmed.
timing: 2026 dates to be confirmed on the official site.
notes: Only a 2025 official listing was found, and I could not reach capaciti.org.za. Campus-based, so KZN students would need to relocate. Check the 2026 intake, stipend, age and other requirements on the official site.

name: Umuzi learnership
field: tech (most programmes are centred on tech jobs)
requirements: Grade 12 certificate (NQF 4) or higher, South African citizen, age 18-35. Selection is by aptitude test, and the highest scorers get preference.
timing: No guaranteed dates. Join the waiting list. New cohorts start nearly every three months.
accreditation: Siyavula's partner page says Umuzi is MICT SETA accredited with an NQF 5 qualification. Confirm on umuzi.org.
notes: Siyavula's partner page gives the age range as 18-34, while Umuzi's own FAQ says 18-35. Use Umuzi's figure.

name: AWS Skill Builder (free digital training)
requirements: None stated. AWS Educate lets minors and people without credit cards register without an Amazon account.

name: Cisco Networking Academy: Skills for All
notes: Mobile-first. The cybersecurity pathway prepares learners for a certification exam delivered by Certiport.

name: MLH Fellowship (Open Source Track)
requirements: Open to students and non-students. Check the eligibility list on the programme page. It is likely aimed at people who can already code.
timing: Rolling applications that close a few weeks before each batch. Batches start every few months, year-round.
notes: A 12-week internship alternative. Confirm delivery mode and full eligibility on the page. Do not record any rule about combining it with Google Summer of Code unless it is confirmed on the official page.

name: Google Summer of Code
requirements: For new contributors to open source. A person cannot have been accepted as a GSoC contributor more than once. Check the contributor guide for the full rules.
pays_learner: Stipend for contributors who pass their evaluations.
timing: One application window per year. The next window has not been announced.
notes: A 12+ week project with a mentor. Not open for applications right now.

name: MTN Skills Academy
field: digital and financial skills, career guidance
requirements: Sign up for free, then complete a career guidance questionnaire.
notes: Courses come through partners. It includes a career-guidance questionnaire, so be ready to explain how this app differs.

name: Vodacom Internship Programme 2027
requirements: Completing or have completed an undergraduate degree by the end of 2026. Minimum B-degree (B-Com, BSc or B-Tech), NQF 7.
timing: Starts 1 February or 1 March 2027. The closing date is not on the official page I saw.
notes: A student news site gave a closing date of 31 August 2026, so the 2027 intake has likely closed. The demo dates are a sample of the next cycle.

name: Vodacom Discover Graduate Programme 2027
requirements: Completing an undergraduate degree by the end of 2026. Minimum B-degree (B-Com, BSc or B-Tech), NQF 7.
timing: A 2-year programme beginning 1 February 2027. The closing date is not on the official listing I saw.
notes: Likely closed for the 2027 intake. The demo dates are a sample of the next cycle.

name: DHET International Scholarships
provider: Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET)
requirements: Each scholarship has its own process and requirements. Read the specific call on the DHET portal.
location: Study abroad, with partners including Germany, China, Hungary and the United States
timing: Varies by scholarship. Check the portal's calendar.
notes: The portal itself did not open for me. The details come from a government magazine. A university document lists the DHET Funda Germany and Mauritius-Africa schemes for 2026/27 as open calls, but check each one on the portal.

name: YES (Youth Employment Service)
requirements: Read the eligibility and registration steps on yes4youth.co.za.
pays_learner: 12 months of working experience with a CV and reference letter at the end.
notes: The details come from a government magazine. Take pay and eligibility from the official site only. Some placements are listed on host employers' careers pages.

name: NSFAS funding for 2027
requirements: Applying for admission to a public university or TVET college and applying for NSFAS funding are separate steps. Check eligibility on nsfas.org.za.
pays_learner: Bursary and loan funding, subject to eligibility.
timing: The 2027 cycle opened on 18 September 2026 and closes on 31 October 2026. NSFAS has said there will be no extension.
notes: An earlier government news report quoted 18 November 2026 from the launch event. NSFAS's own page lists 31 October 2026, and NSFAS says there will be no extension. Applying for admission to a university or TVET college is a separate step from applying for NSFAS funding.

name: FNB App of the Year Hackathon 2026
provider: FNB App of the Year (run by Geekulcha)
requirements: Create a team profile before the hackathon. Submit a deck of up to 10 slides, a demo video of up to 90 seconds, and the SSDLC and Lean Business Canvas forms.
timing: Kickoff Friday 23 October 2026 at 10:00. The hackathon ends Sunday 25 October. Submissions close Monday 26 October at 23:59.
notes: Dates come from the organiser's participant details.
